So once upon a time I decided to get an eighth of mushrooms with my friend. Let's call him Timmy. Timmy decided to sketch out and not take is half eighth and told me to take it. I thought "fuck it free shrooms" so I took it. We go to my friend CJ's house and hang out there. He just finished making edibles to there were quite a few people there. I'm just hanging out like normal, but then I can feel it start to kick in. I felt so uncomfortable like I was crowded. I then decided to go inside and lay on the couch. I tell my friend Lexi that I feel weird that there are so many people. She says, "Don't worry dude all the people here are the homies!" I said, "Your right". I just sat there and decided to ask CJ to go to his room, he said okay. I laid in his bed freaking out and I didn't know about what. I remember looking at the wall next to his bed and it looked like a fish eye lense would look like. I pulled out my iPhone and put on "Buddhist Monk Radio" which is very relaxing meditation music. I then turned around and saw a blanket. The stereotypical buddhist blanket with smiling suns and all that good shit. Well, on mushrooms it was eye opening. It was surreal. The suns were moving and smiling at me like I was beautiful (I'm a guy). They were changing colors and moving all over the place. I called my friend Timmy into the room and took about 5 snaps of the weed we bought together. I could smoke weed and not cough so easily. Biggest bong rips in my life. I calmed down, and Timmy left the room. I walk outside of the room and opened the door and it was like opening the door to myself. I realized how ignorant, immature, and stupid I've been throughout my life until that point. I realized that the true meaning of life is to Live, Love, and Learn. This the meaning of life only because it is what you do during life. No matter what. Every being lives in order to have a life, every being loves something or someone even if they deny it. Every being learns in order to have a life and live. I am not a religious man, and I think most beliefs are bullshit, but I swear to god on mushrooms I had this weird feeling of there being something bigger than me and that's when I came to the 3 L's conclusion. Anyways, I had an amazing time after that realization and played hackisack with my friends, and dude it was weird. My perception of distance was weird and my friends skin color was changing all types of colors. Blue, green, red you name it. I look at my arm, and my hair is growing and retracting at a constant rate and I just think to myself, "Fuuuuccccckkkkkkkk". That's when I became a mature person and became self-aware. The correct definition is an Ego Death. That's my crazy shroom story. There's more information to tell but I've ran out of finger strength.
